thag3.10:1.1: Ahū tuyhaṃ pure saddhā, sā te ajja na vijjati. yaṃ tuyhaṃ tuyhaṃ ev' etaṃ; n' atthi duccaritaṃ mama. || ||
thag3.10:2.1: aniccā hi calā saddhā evaṃ diṭṭhā hi sā mayā; rajjanti pi virajjanti, tattha kiṃ jiyyate muni. || ||
thag3.10:3.1: paccati munino bhattaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ kule kule; piṇḍikāya carissāmi, atthi jaṅghabalaṃ mamā 'ti. || || Sāṭimattiyathero.
